rules.title: Real estate-related transactions discrimination based on protected classes
rules.requirement: It is unlawful to discriminate in granting mortgage loans, financial assistance, selling, brokering, or appraising residential real estate based on race, color, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, children, national origin, genetic information, ancestry, age, or handicap.

coverage.summary: Covers persons whose business includes granting mortgage loans or engaging in residential real estate-related transactions.

rules.exemptions: Age-related exceptions include inquiries for creditworthiness, empirically derived credit systems meeting specific criteria, credit life/disability insurance, failure to grant to minors, or loans exceeding life expectancy.
rules.quoted_span: For any person whose business includes granting mortgage loans or engaging in residential real estate-related transactions to discriminate against any person in the granting of any mortgage loan or in making available such a transaction, or in the terms or conditions of such a loan or transaction, because of race, color, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation which shall not include persons whose sexual orientation involves minor children as the sex object, children, national origin, genetic information, ancestry, age or handicap.

rules.title: Access to multiple listing service and real estate organizations
rules.requirement: It is unlawful to deny access to, membership in, or participation in multiple listing services or real estate organizations, or to discriminate in the terms or conditions thereof, on account of race, color, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, children, national origin, genetic information, ancestry, age, or handicap.

coverage.summary: Covers persons providing services or facilities relating to selling or renting dwellings.

rules.quoted_span: For any person to deny another person access to, or membership or participation in, a multiple listing service, real estate brokers' organization, or other service, organization, or facility relating to the business of selling or renting dwellings, or to discriminate against such person in the terms or conditions of such access, membership, or participation, on account of race, color, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation which shall not include persons whose sexual orientation involves minor children as the sex object, children, national origin, genetic information, ancestry, age, or handicap.

rules.title: Housing accommodations discrimination in rental or sale
rules.requirement: It is unlawful for housing owners, lessors, brokers, or managing agents to refuse to rent, lease, sell, or negotiate for housing accommodations, or to discriminate in terms, conditions, privileges, facilities, or services, or to make discriminatory inquiries or records based on race, religious creed, color, national origin, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, genetic information, ancestry, marital status, veteran status, or handicap.

coverage.summary: Applies to publicly assisted, multiple dwelling, or contiguously located housing accommodations, condominiums, and housing cooperatives.

rules.exemptions: Age restrictions do not apply to minors, elderly housing developments, or certain 55+ or 62+ communities complying with federal law.
rules.quoted_span: For the owner, lessee, sublessee, licensed real estate broker, assignee or managing agent of publicly assisted or multiple dwelling or contiguously located housing accommodations or other person having the right of ownership or possession or right to rent or lease, or sell or negotiate for the sale of such accommodations, or any agent or employee of such a person, or any organization of unit owners in a condominium or housing cooperative: (a) to refuse to rent or lease or sell or negotiate for sale or otherwise to deny to or withhold from any person or group of persons such accommodations because of the race, religious creed, color, national origin, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, which shall not include persons whose sexual orientation involves minor children as the sex object, age, genetic information, ancestry, or marital status of such person or persons or because such person is a veteran or member of the armed forces, or because such person is blind, or hearing impaired or has any other handicap

rules.title: Discrimination in other covered housing accommodations
rules.requirement: It is unlawful to refuse to rent, lease, sell, or discriminate in terms or make inquiries regarding protected classes for covered housing accommodations or land intended for housing.

coverage.summary: Applies to other covered housing accommodations and land.
coverage.owner_condition: Exempts the leasing of a single apartment or flat in a two-family dwelling where the other unit is owner-occupied.

rules.exemptions: Excludes the leasing of a single apartment or flat in a two-family dwelling, the other unit of which is occupied by the owner as a residence.
rules.quoted_span: For the owner, lessee, sublessee, real estate broker, assignee or managing agent of other covered housing accommodations or of land intended for the erection of any housing accommodation included under subsection 10, 11, 12, or 13 of section one... (a) to refuse to rent or lease or sell or negotiate for sale or lease or otherwise to deny or withhold from any person or group of persons such accommodations or land because of race, color, religious creed, national origin, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation...

rules.title: Reasonable modifications and accommodations for individuals with disabilities
rules.requirement: Discrimination on the basis of handicap includes refusing to permit reasonable modifications at the tenant's expense, refusing reasonable accommodations in rules, policies, practices, or services, or discriminating against a person due to their need for modifications or accommodations.

coverage.summary: Applies to housing providers and accommodations.

rules.exemptions: For publicly assisted housing or multiple dwellings of 10 or more units, reasonable modifications are at the owner's expense unless it imposes an undue hardship.
rules.quoted_span: For purposes of subsections 6 and 7 discrimination on the basis of handicap shall include but not be limited to: (1) a refusal to permit or to make, at the expense of the handicapped person, reasonable modification of existing premises occupied or to be occupied by such person if such modification is necessary to afford such person full enjoyment of such premises; provided, however, that, in the case of publicly assisted housing, multiple dwelling housing consisting of ten or more units, or contiguously located housing consisting of ten or more units, reasonable modification shall be at the expense of the owner or other person having the right of ownership

rules.title: Discriminatory housing advertisements and notices
rules.requirement: It is unlawful to make, print, publish, or cause to be published any notice, statement, or advertisement regarding housing sales or rentals that indicates any preference, limitation, or discrimination based on protected classes.

coverage.summary: Applies to multiple dwelling, contiguously located, publicly assisted, or other covered housing accommodations.

rules.quoted_span: For any person to make print, or publish, or cause to be made, printed, or published any notice, statement or advertisement, with respect to the sale or rental of multiple dwelling, contiguously located, publicly assisted or other covered housing accommodations that indicates any preference, limitation, or discrimination based on race, color, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation which shall not include persons whose sexual orientation involves minor children as the sex object, national origin, genetic information, ancestry, children, marital status, public assistance recipiency, or handicap or an intention to make any such preference, limitation or discrimination except where otherwise legally permitted.

rules.title: Public assistance and housing subsidy discrimination
rules.requirement: It is unlawful for any person furnishing credit, services, or rental accommodations to discriminate against any individual who is a recipient of public assistance or housing subsidies, or because of any program requirement.

coverage.summary: Applies to persons furnishing credit, services, or rental accommodations.

rules.quoted_span: For any person furnishing credit, services or rental accommodations to discriminate against any individual who is a recipient of federal, state, or local public assistance, including medical assistance, or who is a tenant receiving federal, state, or local housing subsidies, including rental assistance or rental supplements, because the individual is such a recipient, or because of any requirement of such public assistance, rental assistance, or housing subsidy program.

rules.title: Discrimination against families with children in housing
rules.requirement: It is unlawful to refuse to rent, sell, or otherwise deny housing accommodations to a person because they have a child or children, or to discriminate in terms, conditions, privileges, or services based on having children.

coverage.summary: Applies to publicly assisted, multiple dwelling, contiguously located, or other covered housing accommodations.
coverage.owner_condition: Exempts dwellings of 3 apartments or less where one is occupied by an elderly/infirm person for whom children would be a hardship, temporary leasing of a principal residence up to one year, or a single unit in a two-family dwelling owner-occupied.

rules.exemptions: Exempts dwellings with three apartments or less with one occupied by an elderly or infirm person where children constitute a hardship, temporary leasing of an owner's principal residence for up to one year, and two-family dwellings where the owner occupies the other unit.
rules.quoted_span: For the owner, sublessees, real estate broker, assignee or managing agent of publicly assisted or multiple dwelling or contiguously located housing accommodations or other covered housing accommodations, or other person having the right of ownership or possession or right to rent or lease or sell such accommodations, or any agent or employee of such person or organization of unit owners in a condominium or housing cooperative, to refuse to rent or lease or sell or otherwise to deny to or withhold from any person such accommodations because such person has a child or children who shall occupy the premises with such person or to discriminate against any person in the terms, conditions, or privileges of such accommodations or the acquisition thereof, or in the furnishing of facilities and services in connection therewith, because such person has a child or children who occupy or shall occupy the premises with such person

rules.title: Blockbusting and unlawful real estate inducement practices
rules.requirement: It is unlawful to directly or indirectly induce or attempt to induce the sale, purchase, or rental of any dwelling by making representations regarding the entry of persons of a particular race, religion, sex, age, handicap, or familial status, or by engaging in unrequested communications or false representations.

coverage.summary: Applies to any person attempting to influence real estate transactions.

rules.quoted_span: For any person to directly or indirectly induce, attempt to induce, prevent, or attempt to prevent the sale, purchase, or rental of any dwelling or dwellings by: (a) implicit or explicit representations regarding the entry or prospective entry into the neighborhood of a person or persons of a particular age, race, color, religion, sex, gender identity, national or ethnic origin, or economic level or a handicapped person, or a person having a child...

rules.title: Sexual harassment of tenants or prospective buyers
rules.requirement: It is unlawful for housing providers, brokers, managing agents, or property owners to sexually harass any tenant, prospective tenant, purchaser, or prospective purchaser.

coverage.summary: Applies to owners, lessees, sublessees, brokers, managing agents, or persons with right of ownership or possession of publicly assisted, multiple dwelling, contiguously located, or other covered housing accommodations.

rules.quoted_span: For the owner, lessee, sublessee, licensed real estate broker, assignee, or managing agent of publicly assisted or multiple dwelling or contiguously located housing accommodations or other covered housing accommodations, or other person having the right of ownership or possession, or right to rent or lease, or sell or negotiate for the sale of such accommodations, or any agent or employee of such person or any organization of unit owners in a condominium or housing cooperative to sexually harass any tenant, prospective tenant, purchaser or prospective purchaser of property.
